tools.automation: Windows UI Automation; no DevTools or WebDriver

limitations: One synthetic HTML task and one cancellation; no semantic model quality claim.
Windows CI runner only, not a user-machine policy override or clean-machine installer test.
UI Automation is instrumentation, not a human usability or accessibility audit.
RSS may double-count shared pages; half-second samples are not absolute peaks or leak proof.
CPU fields sum counters of currently observed processes, not total lifetime CPU of the run.
The separate metadata server and test harness are outside the sampled application tree.
window_differential: initial maximized -> restored content fits -> maximized content fits

after_start_capture.meaning: after authorization; not an atomic RUNNING snapshot

first_close_core_quiescence.scope: captured Python/Ollama descendants; WebView sharing not certified

resource_scope: Only first opening, prepare, first inference and brief after-work observation. Reopening and cancellation verified functionally, not resource-sampled.
cancellation_scope: Second attempt cancelled before a second model call; no native mid-generation cancellation claim.
